en: A black-and-white postcard view of a large Baroque-style castle set on a wooded hillside. The multi-storey building has a hipped roof with dormer windows and small towers, and is partly covered with ivy. In the foreground are landscaped gardens with paths, hedges, trees, and a circular pond featuring a small fountain. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.
